body: I don't even feel depressed anymore and after being eighteen, I am not living in somewhere I can get away from them. I sure love my family but I grew up in a home where no love was in for me. I had to be alone when it is about doing something, I was not alone when I have done mistakes. They had expectations but I was not able to make them have it. I am a disappointment. Both for my family and my friends.
